R1039.summary: Christiaan Albrecht van Rechteren, the States General's new envoy to Catherine II, to the Griffier: De Swart advised him not to hand his letter to Grand Duke Paul, since it would rouse jealousy at court; sure that all his letters are opened, he asks leave to send couriers and asks for the reply in cipher, since an unciphered reply would help the discovery of the cipher.
R1039.en:
[margin] Dated 23 Sept / 4 Oct 1785. Received 25 October 1785. Secret.
Deciphered missive from the Count van Rechteren tot Borgbeuningen.

Right Honourable Sir!

On my arrival here, speaking with Mr De Swart about my first audience, that gentleman asked me whether I also had a
letter for the Grand Duke; I having answered that I had, His Honour strongly advised me against handing it over, as it
could rouse nothing but jealousy at the Court; adding that this would harm the affairs of the State, and that I could
safely leave it, since there had been a case with Mr Meinertshaagen, who had also held back his letter to the Grand
Duke.

Mr de Swart's long experience and the knowledge he has of this Court, together with the reassurance that he answered
for it, have made me not carry out this part of my Instruction.

snip.cap: Head of the deciphered letter, “Ont cyfferde Missive”, 23 Sept/4 Oct 1785, with the cipher groups down the margin
snip.credit: Nationaal Archief, The Hague, via DECODE R1039

system: Numerical code of up to three digits with dots and bars over single digits that are part of the code; Rechteren's legation code (NA legation in Russia inv. 158, not online).
